reason: Repairs the 30 test nodes red on pristine origin/main 3e65cc9 (and b4debc3) plus one load-sensitive node, each traced (git bisect or before/after runs) to the commit that changed the behaviour. Product fixes: context.py treats a published output limit at or above the window as no separate limit (since #521 such a model defaulted its output to window-1, leaving one input token, so every chat was refused); chat.py counts catalog discovery calls before the running one (#559's ledger made the limit refuse the 8th search instead of the 9th); harnesses.py classifies a detached-browser refusal as an unavailable resource with no side effects and honours the before-execution marker; tool_catalog.py marks its pre-execution refusals; vault_probe.py moves the secretstorage import out of its try (frozen-runtime guard). Stale tests are updated to the contracts that replaced theirs: #520 tool-failure envelopes (test_harnesses x5, test_tool_catalog x2, subagent limit), #521 visible routing prose, automatic tool choice without finish_response and model output maxima (test_chat_leftovers x3, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery, test_synthesis_tool_declarations, test_model_output_budget x15), #536 allow_agent_messaging (test_api goal conversation), and a bounded wait for scope-expiry close in test_automation_runtime. Selected: every file holding a repaired node, whole, plus the direct suites of the changed code (test_context.py, test_tool_failures.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_diagnostic_sensitive.py).
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Only the one repaired node of tests/v3/test_api.py is selected: api.py is unchanged and the rest of that file passes on pristine main. No UI, native or Playwright selection: src/nebula/v3/** matches the core-api catch-all, but no route, request/response shape or rendered surface changed; the changes are model-facing failure classification, output sizing and one catalog count. Harness and provider-chat suites beyond test_harnesses.py and test_harness_provider_subagents.py are not selected: the gateway change only adds a before-execution condition and the browser refusal class. No real-Core or live-provider run: every change is exercised end to end through ChatService or the harness gateway with local stores.
